description: Western Heart central moveset library entry — v1 (worker 47, 2026-10-22). Additive over the v2 moveset-editor contract (docs/movesets/MOVESET-SCHEMA.md): every library entry can be projected to a v2 move by the assembler.

anim_ref.description: Preview-animation clip reference for live preview. Format game:character:row-or-slug, e.g. t3:king:row:44, doa:bass:palm-jab, wrestling:mk-0985.

damage_raw.description: Raw source-game damage (T3 bank value, DOA value, or null).

id.description: Globally unique library id. Namespaces: t3:<fighter>:row:<n>, wrestling:<mk-id>, wmxix:<id>, doa:<char>:<slot>, vf:<char>:<slot>, vf5:<char>:<slug>, wh:<slug>.

input.description: Tekken notation (1/2/3/4, d/f+2, 1,2, qcf+2, 1+3 ...). null when not decoded (T3 rows — the #615 fidelity engine owns that decode; ASSEMBLY assigns the slot).

name_status.description: Honesty flag: 'DB label ...', 'DOA community movelist name', or 'auto-label — ... never an invented canon name'.

provenance.description: Source truth. estimated[] lists every field that is estimated rather than decoded.

wh.description: WH-specific tuning overrides the assembler applies on top of the source values.

title: MovesetLibraryEntry
